Fearspends: Spend Fear: the forest goes abruptly silent — every hybrid animal stops at once. Players feel watched. (Sets up either the strixwolf or the Bramble ambush.) A compliance stamp peels off a trunk and the wound underneath looks almost like a carved face — a quiet seed for the Treehouse's carved-face trees later. Distant, unhurried movement keeping pace with the carriage. Never resolved here. Pure dread fuel.

Corporate route signs, liability placards, and numbered posts sit against trunks wide enough to make the signage look temporary. Rain ticks through high leaves; birdsong stops in bands ahead of the party; route fixtures click softly when the Keystone passes.
